  • 日本語名: 女装百合畑
  • 英語名: Josou Yuribatake

别名

  • 女装百合畑

あらすじ

Ayanohara Academy is a secret garden where affluent trap heiresses form sisterly bonds and many pseudo yuri romances flourish.

Despite cross-dressing being a venerated practice at the school, the main character Iori, a trap from an unaffluent background, has trouble fitting in since she doesn’t like to cross-dressing and refuses to do so.

item.title: Josou Shinwa
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: No~Strike
  • 発売日: 2020-07-17
  • スコア: 6.7299999999999995/10 (262 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 女装神話
  • 英語名: Josou Shinwa

あらすじ

Our protagonist thought he could return to his daily routine after the rivalry between his two new wives ended…

But alas, it was not to be, since the sudden appearance of the newly appointed crossdressing goddess, Tamaki, shook things up.

While our protagonists were gone in another dimension, Subaru—who was exiled by Mishiro once upon a time—returned, and made Tamaki the main goddess of the shrine, assuming direct control over the shrine’s authority.

あらすじ

After enduring countless years of ascetic training to inherit his parent’s shrine, our protagonist is surrounded by a parade of cuties with a surprise!

Despairing over not being able to enjoy a “normal” love, he seeks the aid of his local enshrined deity. And as if the heavens themselves heard his plight, the Goddess manifests in front of him.

item.title: Josou Sennen Oukoku

  • 日本語名: 女装千年王国
  • 英語名: Josou Sennen Oukoku

别名

  • Joso Millennium

あらすじ

The hero is summoned to a different world. Able to wield a sacred sword and blessed by the goddess. He teams up with heroines to defeat the demon king as that is the only way he can be sent home. But he is soon disappointed when that plan fails. He is told, he can’t be sent back until he brings peace to the land. He now has to help forge a peace treaty between the demon tribes and the human kingdom. But each heroine has her own agenda on how the treaty should be written and will do anything to persuade the hero.

  • 日本語名: 女装学園（孕）
  • 英語名: Josou Gakuen

别名

  • Jogaku

あらすじ

In distant future, women are few as the birth-rate of woman has significantly declined. To defeat low birth-rate, the Japanese government secretly initiates “cross dressers pregnancy project”. The project aims to make cross dressers who have suitable potential as couple and make them pregnant by mandatory law.

The protagonist Nogi is informed by his teacher Yomoda Sakae he’ll be preforming in this breeding project with himself (Yomoda), his Junior BL lover Chiharu and his popular classmate/rival Rei. Initially Nogi is completely against the idea of being together with a man but is soon left without a choice…
